name: Quran.com API
description: The official v4 REST API powering Quran.com. Provides deep programmatic access to chapter metadata, verse-by-verse data, word-by-word linguistics, audio recitations, Tafsirs (commentaries), search, and audio timestamps/segments.

authentication.description: Publicly accessible API. No API key required.

rateLimit.policy: Open access with standard rate limiting. Developers are encouraged to use client caching and CDN endpoints.

endpoints.name: List Chapters (Surahs)
endpoints.description: Lists all 114 chapters with names, transliterations, revelation place, order, verses count, and page ranges.

endpoints.name: Get Single Chapter Info
endpoints.description: Fetches metadata for a single chapter.

endpoints.name: Get Chapter Historical & Contextual Info
endpoints.description: Fetches historical background, revelation circumstances, and themes of a chapter.

endpoints.name: Get Verses by Chapter
endpoints.description: Fetches verses of a chapter with word-by-word breakdowns, translations, tafsirs, and audio timestamps.

endpoints.name: Get Verses by Page
endpoints.description: Fetches all verses on a specific Mushaf page (1 to 604).

endpoints.name: Get Verses by Juz
endpoints.description: Fetches all verses in a specific Juz (1 to 30).

endpoints.name: Get Verse by Key
endpoints.description: Fetches a single verse by its key (e.g. 2:255).

endpoints.name: List Translations Resources
endpoints.description: Lists all available translations with resource IDs, author names, language codes, and license info.

endpoints.name: List Tafsir Resources
endpoints.description: Lists all commentary resources (Ibn Kathir, Al-Jalalayn, Ma'arif, etc.).

endpoints.name: List Recitation Resources
endpoints.description: Lists audio reciters with recitation IDs, styles (murattal, mujawwad), and audio file URLs.

endpoints.name: Get Tafsir by Ayah
endpoints.description: Fetches detailed scholarly commentary for a specific verse.

endpoints.name: Get Chapter Recitation Audio
endpoints.description: Returns the complete chapter audio stream URL and duration for a given reciter.

endpoints.name: Search Quran
endpoints.description: Searches Quranic Arabic text and translations with highlighting.
